intro: Furen's Armor marks the culmination of an aspiring warrior's quest to assist the master smith Furen Longbeard in Stormwind. By gathering spider fangs, chimaera horns and a vial of phlogiston, the adventurer helps Longbeard forge a resilient suit of fire-hardened mail. In return for their aid, Longbeard rewards the warrior with the finished mail and pledges to share his newfound metallurgical techniques across the Alliance.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here's your armor, friend. This will stand up to the strongest assaults or my name isn't Furen Longbeard!
And I have to thank you. I learned a lot while working with the materials you brought me. I think I'll have another breakthrough one day!
I'm going to send what I learned to other blacksmiths of the Alliance.
I'll tell them you were a big help, and maybe they'll want to return the favor.
